title: KUL NAZME QAAENAAT HAI ZAHRA KE HAATH MEI
body:
KUL NAZME QAAENAAT HAI ZAHRA KE HAATH MEI
SAYYEDA TAHERA ...... 10
KUL NAZME QAAENAAT HAI ZAHRA KE HAATH ME 3
SHERE KHUDA KA HAATH HAI ZAHRA KE HAATH ME
<<DIVIDER>>
1 ALLAH NE MANGAA LI SARE ARSH ROTIYA 2
KOI TOH AISI BAAT HAI ZAHRA KE HAATH ME
2 JIS GHAR SE CHAL RAHA HAI ZAMAANE KA HAR NIZAAM 2
USKI MA AASHIYAT HAI ZAHRA KE HAATH MEI
<<DIVIDER>>
3 BETI KO SAATH LAAYE HAI IS WAASTE RASOOL 2
NAJRANIYO KI MAAT HAI ZAHRA KE HAATH ME
4 MAALIK HAI JISE CHAHE YEH TABDEELIYA KARE 2
5 KEHNE LAGE HUSSAIN YEH ROOMAAL BAANDH KAR 2
<<DIVIDER>>
JAA HUR TERI NIJAAAT HAI ZAHRA KE HAATH ME
6 HAATHO ME HAATH SHABBARO SHABBIR KE NAHI 2
ISLAM KI HAYAAT HAI ZAHRA KE HAATH MEI
7 KAISE MITAAYE KOI AZAA KI NISHAANIYA 2
<<DIVIDER>>
HIFZE TABARRUKAAT HAI ZAHRA KE HAATH ME
8 TASBIHE FATEMA NE TAKALLUM BATA DIYA 2
HAR RADDE MUSHKILAAT HAI ZAHRA KE HAATH MEI
author: Mir Hassan Mir
